text: Planning a trip can be exciting but also stressful. Before you travel, you need to book tickets, find a hotel, and decide what to see. When you arrive in a new country, you experience different cultures, traditions, and ways of life. Trying local food is one of the best parts of travelling, and it helps you understand the place better. Sometimes you face language barriers, but you can usually communicate with gestures or simple words. These small challenges often make the journey more interesting. In the end, you return home with unforgettable memories and stories to share with your friends and family.
